relevance_note: Case report of one boy with biochemically confirmed SSADH deficiency: "We report the MRI findings in a 12-year-old boy with SSADH deficiency."
method_note: Built by hand from a full read of the paper; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans. No genetic testing or ALDH5A1 variant is reported for any person (diagnosis by urinary GHB and lymphoblast SSADH activity), so the variants table is empty. The index patient was described earlier ('described in detail in a previous report [3]'). Two previously published people are included under the v4 passing-mention rule because the text gives individual-level facts: 'ref [6] patient' (11-year-old Turkish boy from Yalcinkaya et al. [6], 'identical MRI findings'), and 'ref [5] patient' (case report [5], cerebellar vermian atrophy and subtle supratentorial white-matter changes; disease label taken from the reference title). The group statement on cerebral atrophy and pallidal hyperintensity from refs [2, 4] is not individual-level and gets no rows. The 'retarded child' phrase in the conclusion is a general statement, not about this patient, so intellectual disability is not reported. 'Development was normal during the first 2 years of life' is recorded as detail on the language-delay row, not as a separate exclusion. Seizures were generalised tonic-clonic seizures induced by vigabatrin; recorded as observed. is_proband left null for the two literature patients. No contradictions found.
